0022600140.text: The Denver Nuggets (1-2, on a one-game losing streak and 10th in the West) visit the New Orleans Pelicans (0-3, on a three-game losing streak and 14th in the West) in the fourth game of the season for Denver. Denver is missing Alpha Diallo (personal), Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), while New Orleans is without Yves Missi (knee bruise). The Nuggets lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 141-135 win in Denver on October 24, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-0.
